name: singlet_sample_level_multi_sample_power_analysis
title: Multi-sample power and sample-number planning
description: Plans the donors per group and cells per donor needed to detect a donor-level condition effect in one cell type at a target power and FDR, from a pilot's donor variance and gene dispersion. Method nb_analytic (default) gives closed-form negative-binomial power with FDR-threshold solving; method simulation runs planted-effect simulations of the pseudobulk test. Writes design grid, power curves and required donors. Do not use it for cell-level, abundance or paired designs.

dataset.description: Pilot dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

design.description: Donor, condition and cell-type keys of the pilot, and the cell type to plan for.

donor_key.description: obs column giving the donor identifier of each cell.

condition_key.description: obs column with two condition levels, constant within donor.

cell_type.description: Cell type to plan for; must occur in at least two donors per condition.

method.description: nb_analytic: closed-form power (default). simulation: planted-effect simulation from the pilot; slower.

target_power.description: Mean per-gene power over planted DE genes that the design must reach.

fdr.description: Target FDR under BY control; the planning threshold is solved to meet it.

effect_log2fc.description: Absolute donor-level log2 fold changes to evaluate.

prop_de.description: Fraction of filtered genes assumed differentially expressed.

donors_per_group.description: Donor counts per condition to evaluate.

cost_donor.description: Cost per donor; with cost_cell gives the cost-optimal cells per donor.

cost_cell.description: Cost per cell; with cost_donor gives the cost-optimal cells per donor.

n_replicates.description: Simulated replicates per design point; cost scales linearly.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

seed.description: Random seed for simulation replicates; nb_analytic is deterministic.

dataset.description: Handle of the pilot dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/power_planning/required_donors. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: cell_type, alpha_star (planning threshold), required_donors_per_group (cells per donor to donors), design_power, cost_optimal_cells (null without costs). Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
